payload.title: Extend ground-truth schema and packet validator for mention attributes
payload.description:
Extend the ground-truth schema and its validator so mention gold can assert the new attributes, and so a labeling agent can check its own output with one command.

## Fields on mention gold

- `status`: `positive` when the line handles a value of the concept; `negative` when the match is only the word (import specifier, connection or template name, prose, config key); `ambiguous` otherwise. Existing semantics.
- `syntax_kind`: identifier, property_key, string_literal, import_specifier, comment, type_name.
- `declaration`: file path and line of the declaration the usage resolves to, its kind (local, parameter, field, function, export), or `unresolved`.
- `type_annotation`: the written type name on that declaration, if any.
- `owner`: the owning code unit, as a stable repo-local name.
- `touches`: zero or more component identity keys.
- `group`: a repo-local declaration-group id (grouping layer).

All new fields are optional; a record asserts only what it labels.

## Also

- Packet files at `tests/benchmark/repos/<repo>/annotations/packets/<issue-id>.yaml`, merged into `annotations/mentions.yaml` only after acceptance.
- A validator command (for example `pnpm run eval:validate-packet <path>`) that checks shape, that every evidence line exists at the pinned commit, and that every candidate line in the packet's file list has exactly one record.
- Bump `ground-truth/1` and update `tests/eval/ground-truth-schema.md` and the skill's copy of it.

## Done when

The validator accepts a hand-written example packet and rejects one with a missing candidate line, a wrong line number, and an unknown field.
